For sign > 0 (hi + sigma): value = (scaled + sqrt(V))/n where scaled = hi*n ≥ 0 (hi ≥ 0). So value ≥ 0 → trunc = floor = _floor_plus(scaled, V, n) ✓. The branch `if scaled >= 0 or scaled*scaled <= radicand` handles it.

For sign < 0 (lo - sigma): value = (scaled - sqrt(V))/n with scaled = lo*n ≥ 0.
- If scaled > 0 and scaled² > V → value > 0 → trunc = floor = _floor_minus ✓.
- Else (scaled <= 0, or scaled² <= V) → value <= 0 → trunc = -floor(-value) = -_floor_plus(-scaled, V, n) ✓ since -value = (-scaled + sqrt(V))/n.

Check _floor_plus(t, V, n) = floor((t+sqrt(V))/n):
- root = isqrt(V) → root <= sqrt(V) < root+1.
- low = (t+root)//n → floor((t+root)/n). Since t+root <= t+sqrt(V), floor((t+root)/n) <= floor((t+sqrt(V))/n). And since sqrt(V) < root+1, (t+sqrt(V))/n < (t+root+1)/n → floor <= floor((t+root+1)/n) which is either low or low+1.
- probe = (low+1)*n - t. We have probe > root (from low*n <= t+root → (low+1)*n > t+root → probe > root ≥ 0 → probe ≥ 1).
- (low+1) is valid iff (low+1)*n <= t+sqrt(V) ⟺ probe <= sqrt(V) ⟺ probe² <= V ✓.
So return low+1 if probe² <= V else low ✓.

Check _floor_minus(t, V, n) = floor((t - sqrt(V))/n):
- high = (t-root)//n; the answer is high or high-1.
- probe = t - high*n. high is valid iff high*n <= t - sqrt(V) ⟺ sqrt(V) <= t - high*n = probe ⟺ probe >= 0 and probe² >= V ✓.
- else return high-1 ✓.
